# Wildlife, monsters and villagers. Generated by tools/gen_creatures.py.
#
#   entity <id>
#     name, model, tint, height, width, speed, health, damage, weight, drops
#     behavior wander | npc | hostile | swim | fly | villager
#     biomes <names>     surface biomes, or cave kinds (cave, mushroom_cave,
#                        crystal_cave, lush_cave, frozen_cave, magma_cave,
#                        webbed_cave); a creature with a cave kind lives underground
#     night              comes out only after dark
#     trait <names>      flees herd jumps territorial hunter prey lazy pack follows
#     anim walk | hop | slither | flap | scuttle | waddle | float
#     tex <name>                 the picture it is painted with (data/textures/entity/<name>.png);
#                                without it, the model's own picture (named after the model)
#     variant <name> [<r> <g> <b>] [model <id>] [size <factor>] [tex <name>]   another look
#     baby <size> <seconds>      young ones: how small, and how long they take to grow
#     gives <item> <seconds>     right click collects it, then again after that long
#     likes <item>               what it follows a player for (with trait follows)
#     trade <item> <n> <item> <n>   takes the first from a player, hands over the second
#     job farmer | builder | guard | <any word>   what a villager does
#     glow <0..15>               not dimmed by the dark
#     tamable                    feeding it what it `likes` makes it yours
#     rideable                   right click with an empty hand to ride (once tamed, if tamable)
#     shoots <damage>            looses at players from a distance
#     sound <id>                 the call it makes
#     hunts <ids...>             the creatures it preys on (its place in the food chain)
